jobs.occupation: Air Freight Pricing Specialist (f/m/d) (Kaufmann/-frau - Spedition und Logistikdienstleistung)
jobs.description: Welcome to Rhenus!The Rhenus Group is one of the leading global logistics service providers. Throughout the entire supply chain, we offer tailored solutions for companies across a wide range of industries. From multimodal transportation and optimal warehousing to seamless customs clearance and innovative value-added services, we stay at the forefront of industry developments and work closely alongside our customers every step of the way.What you can expect:- In this position, you will receive, review and process ad-hoc pricing requests from both the global network and own-controlled customers - including the clarification of customer requirements, if needed.- In addition, you will work closely with local operations and sales to understand customer needs, apply pricing according to local price sensitivity, and support the execution of margin and pricing strategies.- You will foster exchange with the Airfreight Pricing & Procurement Team (e.g., for shipment solutions over 1.5 tons) and the Gateway Team in Frankfurt to develop competitive and operationally feasible solutions.- Furthermore, you will ensure thorough documentation of all quotations and provide insightful reporting to local P&L responsible parties, local sales, the airfreight product team, and the Gateway.- Last but not least, you will be responsible for the follow-up on all provided spot quotations and related inquiries - ensuring feedback is received, success rates are monitored through standard reporting, and coordination with the Commercial Team is maintained. You will also follow customer-specific pricing instructions precisely.What you bring:- You have already gained previous experience in airfreight operations or sales, providing a solid foundation in industry processes and commercial dynamics.- A self-reliant working style combined with the ability to perform well under pressure in time-sensitive environments is one of your key strengths.- You have a confident and professional demeanor in negotiations and in communication with both customers and suppliers.- Naturally, you bring a strong numerical understanding and a sharp eye for detail, supporting accurate and data-driven decision-making.- Business fluency in English, along with strong verbal and written communication skills, round off your profile.Your benefits:- Cafeteria: Fuel your day with nutritious meals at our on-site cafeteria.- Continuous Training: Sharpen your skills and advance your expertise with our professional development programs.- Exclusive Discounts: Benefit from attractive employee discounts on different products and services.- Flexible Working Times: We offer flexible schedules to suit your lifestyle and personal commitments.- Free Parking: No one likes to start their day hunting for a spot - we've got guaranteed free parking spaces for everyone.- Monthly Gift Vouchers: Enjoy an extra amount each month for fuel, groceries, or entertainment.

jobs.description: Senior Cloud Developer “SURU Connect” (f/m/d)Are you ready to kickstart your career and take on a versatile role right from the start? To strengthen our team, we are looking for a Junior Accounting Specialist (m/f/d) at the earliest possible opportunity.As a Senior Cloud Developer , you will design, build, and operate cloud-native applications that are core toSURU Connect and SURU SignalHub .Working across the full solution lifecycle, you will turn customer and business needs into scalable, secure, andreliable digital products. Integrate IoT devices, connectivity providers, externalplatforms, and customer systems, selecting the technologies andarchitectural patterns that best fit each usecase rather than being tied to a fixed stack- Work closely with product, business, customers, and external partners to identify valuable use cases andtranslate them into effective technical solutions. performance, and delivery automation.Contribute to architecture discussions, code reviews, technical standards, and knowledge sharing, while usingAI-assisted development tools and AI agents  extensively for implementation, testing, debugging,documentation, quality assurance, and automatedsoftware deliveryWhat You´ll Bring:- 5+ years  of professional software development experience, including substantial experience with cloud-based or distributed applications- Strong professional experience with C# and modern .NET , including ASP.NET Core, asynchronousprogramming, dependency injection, testing, and production-grade development- Strong practical experience with Blazor  and the ability to build maintainable web applications within the.NET ecosystem- Solid understanding of software architecture, REST APIs, distributed systems, event-driven architectures,asynchronous processing, and messaging-based integrations- Practical experience designing and operating applications on AWS , including compute, storage,databases, messaging, security, and monitoring- Strong experience with PostgreSQL, SQL, data modelling, and Entity Framework Core- Practical experience with Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, containers, automated testing, observability, andproduction operations- Ability to work across the full application stack , from backend services and integrations to Blazor-baseduser interfaces- Ability to evaluate and adopt new cloud services, frameworks, development tools, and architecturalapproaches where they provide clear technical or business value- Strong practical experience with AI-assisted software development and coding agents, including AI-supported quality and delivery workflows- Strong problem-solving, communication, and technical ownership , with the ability to work proactivelywith customers, product stakeholders, and other engineering disciplines- Proficiency in both English and German  (German at least B1)Nice to Have:- Experience with IoT platforms, smart metering, telemetry ingestion, MQTT, connected devices, orindustrial integrations- Experience designing highly observable and resilient distributed systems- An AWS certification  such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect or AWS Certified DeveloperWhat´s In It For You:- Small, agile teams where your work and voice have real impact- Direct influence on architecture and technical conferences and continuing your professional developmentWhy Join SURU?A pipe-related water damage incident happens every 30 seconds in Germany alone.
